episode_title: Grok Bot: The 24/7 Autonomous Cloud Employee (V3 Master)
topic_overview: xAI's Grok Bot deploys persistent cloud virtual machines that operate 24/7, mapping human DOM intent and executing complex workflows autonomously via Colossus and real-time X telemetry.

hook_strategy.archetype: The Trinity Hybrid Nuke (Brown x Kallaway x Ramonov with Grok Edge)
hook_strategy.spoken_words: Stop chatting with AI. Grok Bot is not a chatbot.
hook_strategy.visual_action: 0.0s: Pitch black screen shattered by electric red strike-through across ChatGPT prompt box. 0.8s: Hard cut to gritty liquid-cooled Colossus server rack with text 'AUTONOMOUS CLOUD AGENT' pulsing. 1.8s: Punch-in zoom on robotic cursor clicking without human input.

mode_a_standalone_script: Stop chatting with AI. Grok Bot is not a chatbot. Traditional AI waits for you to type, then dies. Grok Bot gets its own persistent virtual machine that runs twenty-four-seven. Watch this: with Teach-a-Task, you screen-record your work once. Scraping data, qualifying leads, or debugging code. Grok maps your DOM intent... [micro-pause] closes the browser, and keeps working while your laptop is shut. It's powered by Colossus—the largest supercomputer on Earth—with direct real-time access to the X firehose. This isn't software you talk to. It's an autonomous employee you delegate to. Steal this exact prompt: 'Map browser path and infer intent: Scan X firehose for breaking AI news, verify top three sources, and dispatch a summary email to my team every morning at six AM.' Save this video right now, and screenshot this blueprint. Because tomorrow, you're either running the autonomous bots... or you're competing with them.

bookmark_takeaway.actionable_framework: The Grok Bot 24/7 Autopilot Protocol (V3 Master)
bookmark_takeaway.exact_copy_paste_prompt: Map browser path and infer intent: Scan X firehose for breaking AI news in the last 12 hours, filter for posts with engagement > 500, verify against top 3 technical sources, and dispatch a summary email to team@company.com every morning at 06:00 AM.
free_zero_dollar_software_stack: 1. Grok on X (Free Tier / Existing X Access)
2. Windows Steps Recorder / Chrome DevTools for DOM mapping
3. Antigravity & Gemini for prompt engineering and visual assets
4. CapCut Desktop (Free) for kinetic subtitles and audio leveling

zero_dollar_feasibility: 100% executable with Gemini, Antigravity built-in image generator for visual metaphors, free Chrome browser screen recording (OBS or native Windows Win+Alt+R), and free CapCut or Premiere editing.
